lines: Fine. I have work to get back to, and anger spoils the day.
All right. I will put the cleaver down and hear you properly.
I am still angry, but I do not need to feed it.
You came to settle this honestly. I can meet you there.
We can stop before either of us says something rotten.
That is enough for me to step away from the fight.
I accept the offer. Do not make me regret taking you at your word.
Let us cool this down before the whole village smells trouble.
You owned what happened without trimming the ugly parts.
I would rather clean the block than carry this grudge another day.
This does not erase the damage, but it ends the quarrel here.
Put your hands down. Mine are already off the tools.
We can speak again once the heat has gone out of us.
I believe you mean it, which is more than I expected this morning.
Keep your promise afterward and we may be square.
Peace leaves more time for useful work. I will take it.
We will call the matter settled, though trust still needs tending.
Take a breath. I have been holding mine too long.
I can live with that answer and return to my smoker.
Enough. We walk away without making another mess.
Too lean. Bring {emerald_cost} {emeralds} if you want this settled.
I counted what you brought. It does not reach {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
That is a portion of the payment, not the whole repair.
Do not ask me to call short weight fair.
The agreement was {emerald_cost} {emeralds}. Bring the amount we named.
Keep these until you can return with everything at once.
Good intentions do not fill an empty side of the scale.
You are still short, and I will not trim the cost to spare the conversation.
Come back after you find the remaining emeralds.
A clean settlement needs the full payment.
I weigh meat for a living. I can count {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
This is a start, but it does not close the matter.
Do not hide a shortage beneath a careful apology.
The price did not change while you were walking here.
Bring the rest and I will listen again.
Partial payment leaves us with the same unfinished quarrel.
I am willing to wait. I am not willing to pretend.
{emerald_cost} {emeralds} puts this behind us. Less does not.
Take your offer back before frustration makes things worse.
Return with the full amount and we can cut this clean.
No. I know bad meat, and I know bad apologies.
Keep {payment_items}. Trust is not ready to trade.
Payment cannot cover what you did while the village still fears you.
I would rather lose the offer than sell you a false peace.
Put {payment_items} away. Seeing them does not make me safer.
The wound is too fresh for bargaining.
You are asking me to forgive before you have changed anything.
Emeralds can replace supplies. They cannot replace trust.
Come back after your actions stop giving us reasons to bar the doors.
I will not weigh this harm like a cut of meat.
The village remembers, even if you are eager to forget.
No bargain works while I expect another knife behind it.
Give us distance instead of gifts.
Your reputation reached this room before you did.
Prove you can pass the smokehouse without causing trouble.
I am not trading away the right to stay cautious.
Keep the payment and show some patience for once.
The answer is no today. Pushing will not improve tomorrow.
I do not believe the danger ends when I accept your offer.
Leave the shop and give everyone time.
